pains.statement: Mobile or call-center channels cannot present a single authoritative account state after a core migration wave.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Incident volume, channel affected, mean time to manual fix.

pains.statement: The group still operates many legacy core platforms; contract migration did not collapse execution topology.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Count active cores; releases required for a simple pricing change.

pains.statement: Regulators or internal audit cannot get field-level mutation history for migrated retail contracts.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Regulatory deadline missed; artifact requested vs delivered.

pains.statement: Agents manually cross-check core banking screens against CRM because no stable read API exists.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Handle time increase; tools re-keyed per ticket.

pains.statement: Another weekend big-bang migration is blocked after customer-visible payment failures.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Failed direct debits, lockouts, or supervisory action.

pains.statement: Payment instruction files fail silently between heritage and target cores during phased migration.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Rejected payments count; file format or cutoff time mismatch.

pains.statement: Compliance reporting fails on undocumented fee and interest calculation logic spread across cores.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Last finding or near-miss; rule that could not be evidenced.

pains.statement: Cannot hire maintainers for dead-stack payment and ledger modules that still settle real money.
pains.suggestedEvidence: Open reqs, contractor dependence, last expert departure.
